purpose: Chronological history of reusable character image-edit rule changes. Append new rule changes; do not erase prior entries.

updates.title: Master image edit rule introduced
updates.reason: Prevent rule interpretation from drifting between image edits and allow lessons from failures to be promoted into permanent reusable rules.
addedRules: baseline -> each variant one-to-one comparison
apparent thick lines must be constructed from multiple repeated fine strokes
single thick digital brush stroke is forbidden as a substitute
prefer local patch editing for local corrections
verify zero changed pixels outside the allowed edit region when technically possible
cowlick free reinterpretation is forbidden
cowlick strand tips must land on the hair
reference-image scope must explicitly state what is and is not imported
new failure -> FAILURE_PATTERN_REGISTRY -> validated reusable recovery -> CHARACTER_GENERATION_PLAYBOOK promotion

updates.title: Deterministic line-style normalization tool introduced
updates.reason: Convert existing formal character art to the common fine-pencil repeated-stroke construction without generative redraw or semantic geometry changes.
addedRules: line-style-only normalization must use deterministic processing before generative editing
base line width remains one fine stroke; apparent thickness comes from repeated offset retraces
formal source SHA guard is mandatory when known
centerline and tolerant silhouette geometry QA are mandatory
each formal source is normalized independently; candidate chaining is forbidden
tool PASS does not equal formal promotion

updates.title: Verified autonomous Dropbox raw-materialization bridge
updates.reason: Avoid repeated user upload requests and prevent stale Dropbox aliases from being mistaken for formal GitHub bytes.
addedRules: GitHub formal path+SHA256 is the only durable byte-identity authority.
Use Library /Dropbox mount plus files.materialize(raw_file) for exact-byte acquisition when native image pixels are unavailable through files.read.
Always SHA256-verify materialized bytes before renderer-parent use.
Do not trust Dropbox filename/path/preview/content_hash alone.
If an obvious alias mismatches, search alternate Dropbox candidates using GitHub blob size/path metadata and verify by SHA256.
Re-expose verified raw files into the current conversation only after SHA verification; conversation attachment IDs remain session-local transport references.
